name: Meter Instruments Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 2006, Meter Instruments Co., Ltd. is a Nanjing, China-based firm dedicated to the research, development, production, and sale of water metering devices. Their comprehensive product line encompasses ultrasonic water meters, ultrasonic heat meters, intelligent flow meters, data concentrators, balancing and control valves, and specialized fire hydrant flowmeter solutions.
